summary: Post-race session state transition handler. Cleans up the D3D resource list, shows the cursor, and - only when the session type is race (7) and the championship mode is not 6 - probes the post-race monitor state, optionally activates post-race monitor dispatch, or sets a session flag path. Then tears down a resource, sets global session state, conditionally closes the scoring gate and updates the scene render, runs two virtual calls on global objects, dispatches per-vehicle state handlers, and ends with a session-state dispatch chain and a zero-guarded division. Always returns 0.

operations.description: Call D3DResourceListCleanup(dword_8AFE88) to release D3D resources held in the list rooted at dword_8AFE88.
Loop calling ShowCursor(1) until its return count is > 0, forcing the system cursor to appear.
Enter the post-race path only when dword_7C56A4 == 7 (race session) and dword_7D0410 != 6 (championship mode not 6).
Call sub_4D21D0(&dword_8ACEE0); the result flags whether the post-race monitor should activate.
Record v1 = (dword_7D0410 == 5), distinguishing the 'mode 5' championship path.
When the probe returned true and the player vehicle object pointer at dword_7C54E8 + 13000 is null, call sub_4BC060(1).
When the probe returned true and mode is not 5, build a post-race monitor object via the virtual interface at dword_7CD8C0 (vtable slot 28, called with 33).
If the monitor object was created, call sub_46BA20(v2, 0) then FieldSetter(v3) on it.
Call LookupDispatch(dword_7CD8C0, aPostRaceMonito, -1), dispatching the string 'PostRaceMonito' on the command interface with the sentinel -1.
Else branch of the probe: when mode is not 5 and dword_7CEC90 is zero, take the session-flag path.
Call GlobalFlagSetter(&unk_7CE24D), sub_42D210(&dword_7C569C, 1), and ArithmeticComparison_8d60(&byte_8AC494) to set up the non-monitor post-race state.
Call ResourceDestroy(&dword_8AD238) to release the session resource.
Call GlobalStateSetter(1) to advance the global session state.
When ScoringGateCheck() succeeds, enter the gate-teardown block.
Call ConditionalGate(dword_7C54E8 + 12) then SceneRenderUpdate(0) to close the scoring gate and refresh the scene.
Call VirtualCallOnDAT008ac4c4_8d80(&byte_8AC494) and VirtualCallOnDAT008ac4c4(&flt_8AC4B0) on the two global objects.
Loop over all vehicles with i from 0 to dword_5C329C.
For each vehicle, if the byte at dword_7C54F0[i] + 196 is set, call StateHandlerDispatch(0).
Call ShortComputation_d410(&dword_5EA510) and GameStateDispatchChain(&dword_5EA510, *(dword_7C54F0[dword_7C54E4] + 18580)) to dispatch the session state for the current vehicle.
Call SafeDivisionWithZeroGuard(&flt_5EA4E8, 0.0), a guarded computation using the float global.
Return 0.
